forum.title: STM32F427 DMA2D FIFO Size
forum.best_answer_content:
This is the answer from our expert:

*The DMA2D FIFOs are 35 bytes long and are handling 8x32 bursts transactions.

The 3 FIFOs are on the same master port so no concurrent operations this means that the output FIFO can not be drained when in put FIFOs are refilling.*

Hope that helps.
forum.content_text: What are the sizes and configurations of the FIFOs (foreground, background, and out) on the STM32F427 DMA2D (Chrom-Art)?
forum.author: cstocks

scraped_replies.html:
This is the answer from our expert:

The DMA2D FIFOs are 35 bytes long and are handling 8x32 bursts transactions.
The 3 FIFOs are on the same master port so no concurrent operations this means that the output FIFO can not be drained when in put FIFOs are refilling.

Hope that helps.
